title: Narrow transfer claims and invalidate impossible bounds when matched counterevidence breaks their causal chain

source.title: Internal RTX 5090 Qwen1.5-MoE cross-vendor configuration-transfer A/B
source.claim_scope: One sealed RTX 5090 fused-MoE screen found that an exact E/N configuration transferred from an AMD MI300X table was correctness-preserving but slower than the generic baseline and a bounded control search; it also falsified a warm-steady-state DRAM lower-bound model. This is single-task negative evidence, not a cross-framework policy verdict.

implementation_recipe: Decompose the broad claim into independently testable structural, reachability, numerical, performance and end-to-end statements.
Capture the exact failing entry point, tensor identity, data preparation, dependency revision, build flags, local overlays, architecture and cache state.
Treat shape-key equality as only a retrieval hint: vendor-specific launch metadata and architecture-local schedules are not transferable candidates until normalized and compiled on the target.
Reproduce one boundary at a time on a matched independent environment and register both confirming and contradicting outcomes.
Attempt to falsify every proposed theoretical lower bound using the unchanged control before using its gap to rank candidates.
When a counterexample invalidates one causal edge, retract that edge immediately while preserving narrower facts that remain supported.
Recompute the mitigation: prefer a context guard, architecture-local search or path gate, and retain a broad rollback only if its affected surface is demonstrated.
validation_recipe: Require the original and counterexample runs to name exact source, binary, inputs, entry point, hardware, cache state and oracle identities.
Check whether a reported non-reproduction exercises the same data format and code path before treating it as contradictory.
For configuration transfer, compare against both the unchanged generic baseline and a bounded architecture-local control over the full frozen shape portfolio.
Reject a transferred candidate when the portfolio regression guard fails even if isolated shapes improve or correctness passes.
For traffic bounds, freeze cold versus warm cache assumptions and record realized routes or unique experts instead of substituting only an expected distribution.
If measured control latency falls below a claimed latency lower bound, mark the model falsified for that workload state and prohibit gap-to-bound claims.
Use negative and positive controls to separate producer, dispatcher, consumer kernel and fallback behavior.
Keep unresolved claims explicit and prohibit performance tuning or promotion that depends on a retracted mechanism.
Ensure summaries, recommendation receipts and relation edges use the latest supported scope rather than stale initial prose.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: Search should move from tuning a falsely accused primitive to isolating the first divergent producer-consumer boundary.
A rejected cross-vendor table transfer should redirect budget to an architecture-local schedule search rather than another semantic-nearest table.
A falsified cold-DRAM model should split the theory into warm-cache and cold-cache envelopes before candidate ranking resumes.
Broad rollback cost should shrink to a scoped compatibility or context gate when only one entry point remains suspect.
Evidence reconciliation can terminate low-value experimentation earlier than another round of parameter tuning.
failure_modes: A non-reproduction uses a different checkpoint format, backend or entry point and is treated as a true counterexample.
An exact tensor-shape key is treated as sufficient transfer evidence across GPU vendors or architectures.
Vendor-only schedule metadata is dropped while the remaining schedule is assumed portable without a target portfolio screen.
A warm repeated benchmark is compared with a cold-DRAM byte model, producing an impossible lower bound.
Expected uniform route occupancy replaces measured unique experts or realized sparse routing.
A valid structural source difference is promoted into an unsupported numerical or performance cause.
The author corrects a comment but the Agent continues routing from a stale title or PR body.
All claims are discarded after one edge is falsified, losing a narrower reproducible issue.
A broad dependency rollback persists after evidence supports only a path-specific compatibility problem.
scope_limits: Counterevidence narrows only the matched claim dimensions; it does not prove universal correctness.
The RTX 5090 result covers one fused-MoE operator shape family and cannot by itself demote all cross-vendor knowledge or establish a shared default.
A configuration that fails warm target screening may still be useful on its source architecture or under another cache/workload state.
Community corrections remain discovery evidence until independently reproduced under the target contract.
A temporary rollback may still be operationally rational even when its original causal explanation is wrong.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: A broad optimization, transfer or regression claim is a chain from source evidence through hardware/workload applicability, path reachability and data contracts to numerical and performance outcomes.
algorithmic_decomposition.partition_axis: individual causal edges, claim dimensions, architecture context and cache-state envelope
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: Retain a claim only when every required causal edge is supported; a matched counterexample retracts the broken edge and all broader conclusions depending on it.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Publish the narrowest surviving claim, explicit unresolved edges and a mitigation whose scope does not exceed the evidence; invalid bounds and unsafe transfer routes remain searchable negative knowledge.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: One bounded reproduction per decision-relevant causal edge plus a frozen shape-portfolio screen rather than repeated whole-system tuning.
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: Structural, architecture and environment checks can run independently, but causal promotion waits for the complete path and regression guard.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: Adds evidence reconciliation, cache-state identity and exact environment capture while avoiding unbounded dependency or kernel experiments.
invariants: no surviving conclusion depends on a retracted causal edge
confirming and contradicting evidence remain visible
structural or shape matches are not silently upgraded to target performance causality
a theoretical lower bound is not exceeded by a valid observation under its declared state
mitigation scope does not exceed the narrowest supported failure surface
anti_patterns: trust the PR title after later discussion retracts its mechanism
rank a cross-vendor schedule from tensor dimensions alone
use a cold-memory roofline for a warm repeated harness
compare approximate synthetic data with a production-format counterexample
treat a missing source file as proof that a neighboring public entry point fails
continue tuning after the motivating causal claim or bound is falsified

candidate_archetypes.name: exact producer-dispatch-consumer replay
candidate_archetypes.template: Freeze one production tensor and replay it through each causal boundary with exact source and binary identities until the first divergence is localized.

candidate_archetypes.name: context-guarded configuration transfer
candidate_archetypes.template: Normalize the source configuration, compile it on the target, compare it with generic and architecture-local controls across the frozen portfolio, and retain it only inside contexts that pass the regression guard.

candidate_archetypes.name: cache-state-aware theory gate
candidate_archetypes.template: Freeze cache state and realized sparse routes, derive separate envelopes, and test the unchanged control against each bound before using any gap for ranking.

candidate_archetypes.name: counterexample-driven mitigation narrowing
candidate_archetypes.template: Split the broad claim, retract dimensions contradicted by matched evidence, and replace broad rollback with the narrowest supported gate or fix.
